cover-combat.webp: Fine-art editorial photograph of a business owner in her forties handing a ring of several old brass keys to a trusted younger colleague in a small workshop office, both standing, the keys passing from hand to hand in the center of the frame, a quiet moment of trust and responsibility. She wears a deep violet blazer, he wears a paper-beige linen shirt with a lavender knit vest. Real skin texture, natural hands, calm serious expressions with a hint of a smile. Background: shelves with neatly labeled boxes reduced to blank cream labels, a window, softly out of focus. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine grain, shallow depth of field with the keys in sharp focus. Lighting: soft side window light, warm peach highlights on the brass, cool deep indigo shadows. Composition 4:5 vertical, hands, keys and faces in the upper two thirds; the lower third is calm, dark, uniform floor and table edge in shadow. Photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render, no text, no letters, no logos.

A woman in a deep violet cardigan stands at the shelf, sliding one binder back into its exact place. Real skin texture, natural hand. Shot on 35mm film, fine grain, medium depth of field. Lighting: dim ambient room in cool deep indigo, warm peach tungsten from the lamp, soft halation. Composition 4:5 vertical, shelves, woman and open binder in the upper two thirds; the lower third is calm, dark, uniform table surface in deep shadow. Photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
cover-docs.webp: Fine-art editorial overhead photograph of a person's hands sorting documents on a large dark oak desk: on the left a loose pile of incoming papers, envelopes and a crumpled receipt, on the right three neat stacks squared into cream folders with lavender and peach tabs, and in the center one freshly printed clean document with a simple layout of blocks and a small table, all rendered as soft illegible marks. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine grain, deep focus, natural colors. Lighting: last warm peach light on the clouds, cool lavender and indigo tones on the sea, the lighthouse beam soft and luminous.
